name: HubSignIn
description: Sign-in, invitation only (direction B). The page is the AuthLayout component (S63): a brand panel on 46% of the width (logo, "Afacerea ta. Într-un singur loc." in `display-xl`; the title "Bine ai revenit" in `display-hub`, the chevron pattern, "© 2026 Ventora Systems") and the form on the sheet, without a card: e-mail, password with "Ai uitat parola?", remember me, language selector, and the note that accounts are created by invitation. No "Creează cont". The phone/dark frame shows the error state (Notice + invalid field).
notes: States are the labelled boards and frames of the preview (Light and Dark; desktop/tablet/phone).
